lines.text: Ghayal hai tera deewana bhai wah bhai wah
Bandook dikha ke kya pyaar karegi
Chehra bhi kabhi dikhana bhai wah bhai wah
Ghayal hai tera deewana bhai wah bhai wah
Bandook dikha dikha ke kya pyaar karegi
Chehra bhi kabhi dikhana bhai wah bhai wah
Ab thehra na kisi kaam ka (Wallah Wallah)
Mai raha Khan mehaz naam kya
Bando se nahi to Allah se daregi
Wada to kabhi nibhana bhai wah bhai wah
(Bandook dikha dikha ke kya pyaar karegi)
Khwaja ji ki paas teri chugli karunga
Angoothi mei qaid teri ungli karunga
(Khwaja ji ki paas teri chugli karunga)
Nacheez pe na chalana bhai wah bhai wah
(Bandook dikha dikha ke kya pyaar karegi)
(Chehra bhi kabhi dikhana bhai wah bhai wah)
